LIQUIDITY AND CAPITAL RESOURCES We continue to maintain a strong financial position. Our primary source of funds for operations is cash from our businesses and our core businesses have been strong cash generators. In 2026, cash on hand, cash flows from operations and availability under our existing credit facility are expected to be sufficient to meet any additional operating and recurring cash needs in the short term and into the foreseeable future. We use our cash for a variety of needs, including but not limited to: ongoing investments in our businesses, strategic acquisitions, share repurchases, dividends, repayment of debt, capital expenditures and investment in our infrastructure. 64 Table of Contents Cash Flow Overview Cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash were $1.7 billion as of December 31, 2025 and 2024. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin is exceptionally high and expanded year over year, sitting far above the sector median, reflecting the pricing power of a subscription-heavy ratings and indices franchise where incremental revenue drops through at minimal cost.

Gross leverage sits comfortably below the sector median and net leverage on a cash-and-investments basis is likewise below peer median, placing the issuer in the strongest indicative risk tier on leverage.

key_risks.text: Shareholder distributions exceed free cash flow and operating cash flow, with buybacks alone absorbing nearly all internally generated cash; the shortfall is bridged by balance-sheet capacity and acquisition-related financing rather than retained earnings.

The disclosed risk discussion flags legal and regulatory exposure in the Indices business, a contingent liability that could consume cash or constrain product economics independent of operating performance and is not captured in the leverage metrics.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is very strong and improved year over year, more than triple the sector median, leaving ample cushion against a rise in funding costs given the modest absolute interest burden relative to operating profit.

Cash flow to debt and free cash flow to debt both exceed sector medians, though both slipped versus the prior year as operating cash flow flattened and capital spending rose; the maturity ladder is well spread with no single year demanding heavy refinancing.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is modest, with leverage just inside the next risk-band boundary and cash flow coverage comfortably above its threshold; headroom is thin on leverage, so a modest EBITDA decline or incremental debt would shift the band.

Our judgement is a stable, high-quality credit: strong margins, superior coverage and diversified recurring revenue offset aggressive capital returns; the current ratio sits below one and below the sector median, and distributions above free cash flow warrant monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 營運利潤率異常高企，並按年擴大，遠高於行業中位數，反映以訂閱為主導的評級及指數業務具備定價能力，增量收入以極低成本直接轉化為利潤。
總槓桿率穩居行業中位數以下，按現金及投資計算的淨槓桿率同樣低於同業中位數，使發行人處於槓桿方面最強的指示性風險級別。

key_risks.text: 股東分派超過自由現金流及經營現金流，單是回購已吸納幾乎全部內部產生現金；缺口靠資產負債表能力及與收購相關的融資填補，而非留存盈利。
披露的風險討論指出指數業務存在法律及監管風險敞口，此或然負債可能消耗現金或限制產品經濟效益，且獨立於營運表現，並未反映於槓桿指標之中。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率非常強勁並按年改善，超過行業中位數三倍以上，鑑於利息負擔相對營運利潤的絕對水平溫和，對融資成本上升留有充裕緩衝。
現金流對債務比率及自由現金流對債務比率均高於行業中位數，惟兩者均較上一年度下滑，因經營現金流持平而資本開支上升；到期結構分佈良好，並無單一年份需要大量再融資。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為溫和，槓桿率僅處於下一個風險區間邊界之內，現金流覆蓋率則穩居其門檻之上；槓桿方面的緩衝空間有限，故EBITDA溫和下降或債務增加即會令區間轉移。
我們的判斷為穩定、高質素的信用：強勁利潤率、優越覆蓋率及多元化經常性收入抵銷了進取的資本回報；流動比率低於一且低於行業中位數，而分派高於自由現金流值得監察。
